description: Add monitors to a site by key (from list_checks). Each key reports added / exists / rejected with the reason (plan, active-monitor limit, needs the WordPress plugin). New monitors get a daily schedule on plans that run daily (Pro and up) and a weekly one on Free, plus a re-run when the site changes on Pro and up (WordPress plugin updates, or pushes via the GitHub App).
name: add_checks
title: Add monitors
